title: Domain Registrations: Deposit Volume Credit on Maximum-Term Extensions
content:
Customers who fund their Harborline Customer Accounts account credit earn the maximum-term volume credit, one of the maximum-term credits, on a maximum-term extension of a Domain Registrations domain.

## 1. Credit

1.1 The maximum-term volume credit is USD 0.50 for each maximum-term year where the account credit deposits posted on the customer's account less than 12 whole months before the day of the order total USD 5000.00 or more.

1.2 It is USD 0.25 for each maximum-term year where those deposits total at least USD 250.00 but less than USD 5000.00.

1.3 It is nothing where they total less than USD 250.00.

1.4 A month counts only once its day of the month is reached.

## 2. Deposits taken into account

Only account credit deposits posted on the customer's Harborline Customer Accounts account are added, and only those posted less than 12 whole months before the day of the order.

## 3. Boundary cases (hypothetical)

| Situation | Result |
|---|---|
| Deposits in the window total exactly USD 5000.00 | upper rate, USD 0.50 for each maximum-term year |
| Deposits total USD 4999.99 | middle rate, USD 0.25 for each maximum-term year |
| Deposits total exactly USD 250.00 | middle rate |
| Deposits total USD 249.99 | nothing |
| Order on 8 September 2029; a deposit posted 9 September 2028 | 11 whole months back: counted |
| Order on 8 September 2029; a deposit posted 8 September 2028 | 12 whole months back: not counted |

## 4. Hypothetical example

Deposits of USD 3000.00 and USD 2500.00 in the window total USD 5500.00; an extension of 4 maximum-term years earns four times USD 0.50, that is USD 2.00.
